basic.name: 普通攻击：碎惘沉击
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的打击，造成冰属性伤害。
第三段打击命中时，伊德海莉将回复10%生命值。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Ice DMG.
On the 3rd hit, Yidhari recovers 10% HP.

special.name: 特殊技：断想
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
挑飞前方敌人，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：缠霜
ex.trigger: 闪能足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
闪能足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
连续上挑两次，并挥出冰雾，造成大量冰属性伤害；
[强化特殊技：缠霜]若成功命中敌人，会在招式发动结束时回复生命值，回复量相当于伊德海莉已损失生命值的33%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform two consecutive upward strikes, then release an icy mist, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If EX Special Attack: Frost Coil hits an enemy, Yidhari recovers HP at the end of the skill equal to 33% of her missing HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：冰曳回震
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：踱寒践约
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]中时，会召唤触手进行协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike against enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, tentacles join in the assault, further enhancing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：终幕·惘事渡却
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
ultimate.trigger: 伊德海莉消耗喧响值开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]后，在30秒内点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring, press [Ultimate] within 30s to activate:

伊德海莉消耗喧响值开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]后，在30秒内点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人进行强力打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
伊德海莉每次消耗喧响值开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，最多发动1次[终结技：终幕·惘事渡却]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring, press [Ultimate] within 30s to activate:
Deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Each time Yidhari expends Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring, she can use Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret once.

facts.text:
伊德海莉会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；
伊德海莉发动招式造成的冰属性伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；伊德海莉进入战场时即可恢复60闪能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，
伊德海莉的当前生命值百分比越低，招式造成的伤害越高；
当伊德海莉生命值低于50%时，获得的增益效果达到最大值，攻击造成的伤害最多提升100%，伊德海莉生命值重新回到50%后，最大值增益效果仍会持续5秒；
伊德海莉通过招式命中获得喧响值降低，伊德海莉生命值降低时，获得喧响值，每降低1%生命值会获得10点喧响值。
facts.textEn:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Ice DMG dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to 100%. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.

cinema.name: 过往沉溺于渊下
cinema.nameEn: The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss
cinema.description: 伊德海莉发动[强化特殊技]所需消耗的闪能减少10点；发动[强化特殊技：缠霜]或[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]后，保持长按「普通攻击」或「特殊攻击」按键，可以消耗35闪能，放弃回复生命值并立即衔接1次[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]，并使本次[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]回复的生命值额外提升100%；伊德海莉的[普通攻击]、[强化特殊技]无视目标20%冰属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's EX Special Attack is reduced by 10. After using EX Special Attack: Frost Coil or EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush. The HP restored by this EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's Basic Attacks and EX Special Attacks ignore 20% of targets' Ice RES.

cinema.name: 何人于此遐思
cinema.nameEn: Who Lingers Here, Lost in Thought?
cinema.description: 伊德海莉的暴击伤害提升40%；成功触发[溯寒]或[追碾]后，持续回复闪能，每秒回复0.5点，最多30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Yidhari's CRIT DMG increases by 40%. Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit grants Adrenaline regen of 0.5/s for up to 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.name: 无人聆听的故事

cinema.descriptionEn: Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection. While in Ether Veil: Wellspring, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.

cinema.name: 并非虚构的慰藉

cinema.description: 伊德海莉消耗喧响值开启或延长[以太帷幕·涌泉]后，将获得[启谛]，持续30秒；[启谛]期间，伊德海莉造成的贯穿伤害提高25%，首次受到致命伤害时，生命值最多降低至1，在5秒内不会战败退场并持续回复25%生命值。
cinema.descriptionEn: After Yidhari spends Decibels to activate or extend Ether Veil: Wellspring, she gains Erudition for 30s. While Erudition is active, her Sheer DMG increases by 25%. Also, upon taking fatal DMG for the first time, her HP is reduced to at most 1, and for the next 5s, she cannot be defeated and will restore 25% HP over time.

basic.name: 普通攻击：碎惘沉击
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的打击，造成冰属性伤害。
第三段打击命中时，伊德海莉将回复10%生命值。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Ice DMG.
On the 3rd hit, Yidhari recovers 10% HP.

basic.name: 普通攻击：霜寒拥覆
basic.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
伊德海莉开始蓄力，蓄力会持续消耗生命值，最多可以进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 时，伊德海莉将根据当前蓄力段数，前方发动强力蓄力锤击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
伊德海莉生命值越多，蓄力消耗生命值的速度越快，最多消耗生命值至最大生命值的25%；
蓄力段数达到2时，招式发动后，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，可以直接衔接第三段[普通攻击：碎惘沉击]，通过这种方式发动的[普通攻击：碎惘沉击]伤害会根据当前的蓄力段数提升，最多提升30%，
蓄力段数达到3时，蓄力招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，可以提前衔接至终结下砸。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When [Basic Attack] is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer attack in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP.
At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Crushing Strike. The DMG of a Basic Attack: Crushing Strike triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%.
At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press [Basic Attack] to chain early into the finishing smash.

basic.name: 霜凝千钧
basic.description:
在[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的蓄力或旋转横挥期间受到敌方攻击时，可以用触手格挡，使受到的伤害降低25%；
如果此时正在蓄力或蓄力段数未满，则会用触手借势反击敌人，回到蓄力姿态并立刻提升1段蓄力等级，对前方敌人造成冰属性伤害；
在霜凝千钧期间点击 【普通攻击键】 ，伊德海莉会基于当前蓄力等级立刻发动[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的下砸终结攻击。
在霜凝千钧期间点击 【特殊技键】 、 【强化特殊技键】 ，伊德海莉会发动必定触发[溯寒]的[特殊技：溯寒追碾]
basic.descriptionEn:
While charging or spinning during Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, if hit by an enemy, Yidhari can block with her tentacles, reducing the DMG taken by 25%.
If charging or not yet at full charge, Yidhari counterattacks with her tentacles, returning to the charging stance and instantly gaining 1 charge level, while also dealing Ice DMG to enemies ahead.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing [Basic Attack] makes Yidhari immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on her current charge level.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] makes Yidhari unleash a Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit that is guaranteed to trigger Surging Cold.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：霜华突撼
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成冰属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Strike forward, dealing Ice DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：断想
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
挑飞前方敌人，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：缠霜
ex.description:
闪能足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
连续上挑两次，并挥出冰雾，造成大量冰属性伤害；
[强化特殊技：缠霜]若成功命中敌人，会在招式发动结束时回复生命值，回复量相当于伊德海莉已损失生命值的33%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform two consecutive upward strikes, then release an icy mist, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If EX Special Attack: Frost Coil hits an enemy, Yidhari recovers HP at the end of the skill equal to 33% of her missing HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：溯寒追碾
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit
ex.description:
在[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的蓄力或旋转横挥期间，点按 【特殊技键】 、 【强化特殊技键】 或在保持按住 【普通攻击键】 的同时点按 【闪避键】 发动：
挑飞前方敌人，造成冰属性伤害；
招式的攻击和敌人的攻击发生相撞时，会触发[溯寒]；
招式攻击命中处于失衡状态下的敌人，且闪能足够时，会触发[追碾]；
触发[溯寒]或[追碾]时，立刻提升蓄力等级至最大值；
招式发动期间点击 【普通攻击键】 ，伊德海莉会基于当前蓄力等级立刻发动[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的下砸终结攻击。
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] while charging or spinning during Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, or press [Dodge] while holding [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Ice DMG.
When the skill's attack collides with an enemy's attack, it triggers Surging Cold.
If the skill hits a Stunned enemy, and with sufficient Adrenaline, it triggers Crushing Pursuit.
Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit instantly raises the charge level to maximum.
During this skill, press [Basic Attack] and Yidhari will immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：极寒重碾
ex.description:
触发[溯寒]或[追碾]，且闪能足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 或 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方冲刺、快速上挑并腾空跃起，随后发动强力的下砸攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
[强化特殊技：极寒重碾]若成功命中敌人，会在招式发动结束时回复生命值，回复量相当于伊德海莉已损失生命值的33%；
若在[溯寒]后发动招式，额外回复15闪能，1秒内最多触发1次。
招式发动后，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，会基于当前蓄力等级立刻发动[普通攻击：霜寒拥覆]的下砸终结攻击。
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
When triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit, and with enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack] to activate:
Dash forward with an upward attack, then leap into the air before delivering a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush hits an enemy, Yidhari heals at the end of the skill for 33% of her missing HP.
If the skill is used after Surging Cold, it grants an additional 15 Adrenaline. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：终幕·惘事渡却
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
ultimate.description:
伊德海莉消耗喧响值开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]后，在30秒内点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人进行强力打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
伊德海莉每次消耗喧响值开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，最多发动1次[终结技：终幕·惘事渡却]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring, press [Ultimate] within 30s to activate:
Deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Each time Yidhari expends Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring, she can use Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret once.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：撼霜驰援
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

105100002.name: 普通攻击：霜寒拥覆
105100002.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
伊德海莉开始蓄力，蓄力会持续消耗生命值，最多可以进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 时，伊德海莉将根据当前蓄力段数，前方发动强力蓄力锤击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
伊德海莉生命值越多，蓄力消耗生命值的速度越快，最多消耗生命值至最大生命值的25%；
蓄力段数达到2时，招式发动后，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，可以直接衔接第三段[普通攻击：碎惘沉击]，通过这种方式发动的[普通攻击：碎惘沉击]伤害会根据当前的蓄力段数提升，最多提升30%，
蓄力段数达到3时，蓄力招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，点击 【普通攻击键】 ，可以提前衔接至终结下砸。
105100002.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When [Basic Attack] is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer attack in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP.
At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Crushing Strike. The DMG of a Basic Attack: Crushing Strike triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%.
At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press [Basic Attack] to chain early into the finishing smash.

对前方小范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]中时，会召唤触手进行协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
105100011.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike against enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, tentacles join in the assault, further enhancing the skill's power.
